subject.title: Compaction should use auth-profile rotation / failover within the same provider

question: Should compaction adopt same-provider auth-profile failover for auto-selected profiles, with user-selected profiles locked and apply-once snapshot semantics?
rationale: The requested behavior aligns with existing auth-profile rotation, but compaction retry semantics affect session-state correctness and need an explicit maintainer-approved boundary before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Land bounded same-provider failover
options.body: Review and land or replace the linked PR with same-provider-only rotation, user-lock preservation, and stable-snapshot apply-once protection.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify a smaller compaction failover contract or extra proof requirements for the linked PR.

options.title: Decline compaction rotation
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue only if maintainers intentionally want compaction to stay stricter than normal agent turns.

recommendation.title: Land bounded same-provider failover
recommendation.body: Review and land or replace the linked PR with same-provider-only rotation, user-lock preservation, and stable-snapshot apply-once protection.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across auth-profile design, model-failover docs, and recent compaction/auth-controller ownership signals.
